description: The chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model for two different models, NESAC ft and SESHA ft, across various optimizations applied. The vertical axis lists the categories of optimizations applied, namely Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates, while the horizontal axis represents the difference in average WER, ranging from 0.000 to 0.003 in increments of 0.001. The chart features grouped bars, with orange representing the NESAC ft model and green representing the SESHA ft model. For each optimization, the NESAC ft model has values of 0.00334 for Normalised, 0.00319 for Add Spacing, 0.00311 for Remove Spacing, 0.00299 for Americanisms, and 0.00257 for Dates, while the SESHA ft model has corresponding values of 0.00323, 0.00344, 0.00306, 0.00302, and 0.00228. The bars are grouped by optimization category, with the NESAC ft and SESHA ft models displayed side by side for each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, and no bars are visually emphasized.
